title: AIWorkflow
description: Schema-driven AI workflow definition. Storage: a single JSON file per workflow. The engine is a pure state machine; task nodes are executed by an external AI agent.

id.description: Globally unique workflow id, also the definition file name.

default_model.description: Hint for the executing agent about which model to use. The engine itself never calls a model.

max_steps.description: Hard guard against infinite branch loops.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) validated against run inputs at startup; required keys MUST be provided.

edges.description: Connections between nodes. If omitted, nodes are chained in array order.

review_config.description: Embedded human acceptance check attached to a task node.

requirements.description: Acceptance criteria shown to the reviewer. Templates allowed: ${var}.

routes.description: Optional verdict routing: APPROVE/REJECT -> node id. Defaults: APPROVE follows edges (null), REJECT redoes this node.

name.description: Human readable name shown in audit records.

prompt.description: [task|branch] Prompt template referencing context via ${var}. Rendered by the engine before served.

model.description: [task|branch] Model hint for the executing agent; overrides default_model. The engine never calls it.

input_schema.description: [task] JSON Schema (draft-07) for information collected FROM THE USER at this node. Missing required keys pause the run until provided.

output_key.description: [task] Context key storing the result. Defaults to node id.

review.description: [task] Require human acceptance after execution before advancing.

routes.description: [branch] answer label -> target node id; [review standalone] verdict -> target node id.

default.description: [branch] Target node id when the answer matches no route.
